<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Pricing and paywall.**
      1 recent review(s) mention pricing and paywall.
      Review window: Aug 2, 2026 - Aug 2, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Robert Taylor_, Aug 2, 2026, 2/5: "Too much offered only for more expensive devices. the app doesn't allow me to remove stuff that I can't use. Very frustrating. Supposedly works with Galaxy Fit 3 but too much of the app doesn't work with it. I realize that the app is free but let us pare it down to what we CAN use. Idiotic way to create loyalty - to say the least."

## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      1 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jul 24, 2026 - Aug 8, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _JWM B_, Jul 24, 2026, 1/5: "Terrible update, completely ruined the app. Since the latest Samsung Health update, this app has gone downhill fast. The new UI is cluttered and confusing, and honestly feels like a step backward instead of an improvement. Worse, the app crashes constantly, which makes my Samsung Watch practically useless for sports and training. I rely on this thing for tracking workouts, and now I can't trust it to even stay open. This is three steps back, not progress. Really disappointing!"
            2. _DJ Mendoza_, Aug 8, 2026, 2/5: "The latest update to th UI is horrific. It's slower and keeps lagging. Logging past meals has become a hassle especially the water intake where it can't keep up. It may look nicer than before but it just performs badly and has discouraged me from opening the app to track meals."
<!--/ir-theme-->
